key_fiscal_facts.value_text: N/A - Concession; costs fully deductible against PITA income; no formal cost oil percentage cap
50% (Petroleum Income Tax Act 2514/1971 - PITA; petroleum companies pay PITA only; standard CIT does not apply)

N/A for concession layer -- Special Remuneratory Benefit (SRB) functions as profit-dependent levy: 0-75% of annual net cash flow above SRB threshold (R-factor type mechanism); maximum 75% of annual cash flow above threshold
5-15% sliding by production (5% below 25000 bpd equivalent; 8% 25000-75000; 12.5% above 75000; gas: 5-8%)
PTTEP (PTT Exploration and Production; state affiliate) participates commercially in most blocks; no mandatory carried interest in standard concession terms
